name: Cardano PRIME — ecosystem grants RFP
amount: Up to $1M per grant from a ₳35M (≈ $5.6M) grant envelope
deadline: No public deadline found; Phase 2 grants roughly Sep–Dec 2026
fit: Live or near-live DeFi teams: dual-stack (EVM + Cardano) wallets, an EVM→Cardano bridge, lending and vault standards, liquidity tooling, batcher standard, second price feed
notes: Rule of thumb: $50 of sustained TVL per $1 of grant. Milestone payments plus transparency reports. Intake is a contact form; the exact format is not published.

name: Orion Fund
org: Draper Dragon, with ₳50M from the Cardano treasury
amount: Seed to Series A; $80M target fund
fit: Startups ready to raise equity or tokens; RWA and institutional DeFi focus
notes: First treasury-backed VC fund on Cardano; returns flow back to the treasury.

name: Maintainer Retainer Program
amount: Recurring pay for maintainers (₳5.9M program in 2025)
fit: You maintain an open-source Cardano library, tool or infrastructure component that others depend on
notes: A good first step before asking the treasury directly: it builds the track record DReps look for.

name: Direct treasury withdrawal
deadline: Always possible; ≈ 30-day vote. Only ≈ ₳43M of spending headroom left until Jul 2027 (our calculation)
fit: Large infrastructure or protocol work with ecosystem-wide impact and a named administrator
notes: Needs a refundable 100,000 ADA deposit, 67% of active DRep stake and a CC vote. 31 of 59 withdrawal proposals passed in 2026.

name: Intersect annual budget process
deadline: 2026 window ran 16 Apr – 8 May. Next cycle probably ≈ Q1–Q2 2027
fit: Open-source infrastructure and tooling teams that want Intersect to administer their funds
notes: Off-chain DRep vote at 67%, then Intersect submits on-chain and pays out through treasury contracts.

name: Project Catalyst — Pilot 2026
deadline: Closed 20 Aug 2026; 12 teams selected 24 Sep. Next round not announced
fit: Products that use USDCx, Pyth, programmable tokens or on-chain identity and can reach mainnet in 3 months
notes: Paid by usage: 40% upfront, up to 40% on usage KPIs, 20% for sustained use.

name: Cardano Accelerator Program (Venture Hub)
amount: CHF 10k per team, 10 weeks, Demo Day (up to ₳2M committed for 2026)
deadline: Fall '26 cohort closed 5 Jun 2026. Next cohort date not announced
fit: Early startups on 'real-world trust': digital product passports, identity, traceability

name: Genesis Pre-Accelerator / Apex Growth Accelerator
amount: Up to $20k (4 weeks) · up to $70k for ≈ 3.5% equity (10 weeks)
fit: Idea-stage to early founders who want a structured program

name: Midnight Night Sky Accelerator & hackathons
amount: 10-week accelerator; hackathon prizes (e.g. $10k Hack Buenos Aires, $12.5k Buildathon)
fit: Privacy apps written in Compact: identity, compliant DeFi, hidden-information games

name: Cardano Builder DAO
org: Member DAO (NMKR, ADA Handle, Minswap, Indigo, Iagon, Vespr, …)
fit: Live apps that drive monthly active users or TVL
notes: How to join is not clearly published.

name: Gimbalabs builder seasons (e.g. Piece of Pie)
amount: Small prize pools (Piece of Pie: 33k ADA)
fit: Solo devs and small teams who want structure and accountability
notes: The 2026 season took 30+ builders to 15 mainnet projects, 3 with real users.

name: Sponsor hackathons (oracles, IO DevEx, event tracks)
deadline: Watch the weekly opportunities digest; IO plans a DevEx hackathon in Nov 2026
fit: Fast prototypes; a good way into later grants
